implementation_statement: Gap: nobody opens the PMS daily EPCS audit report (21 CFR 1311.215(b)) or reviews access reports. The PMS keeps audit records for the contract term and protects them from deletion (1311.205(b)(16)). Gap: suite audit logs are kept only for the plan default, shorter than one year.
An independent HIPAA security consultant assessed 15 controls on 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-06 (P07). POL-02 requires an annual assessment.

The MSP's tool lists the 5 desktops and 2 laptops. Gap: no inventory of the packaging workstation, the delivery phone, network devices, SaaS services, or where ePHI is stored. Planned: one-page inventory by 2026-10-31.

Gap: no contingency plan, emergency mode procedure, or downtime card. Planned: a short contingency plan built from the BIA (P05) with a downtime card at each station, the partner pharmacy arrangement, and a hurricane checklist, by 2026-11-30.
Gap: SYS-07 has never been restore-tested and the plan has never been exercised. Planned: first restore test 2026-09-30, then quarterly; annual tabletop with the P08 runbook.
Gap: one internet line with no failover; the PMS, phones, and fax all depend on it. Planned: MSP-installed cellular failover router by 2026-11-30.

The PMS vendor backs up PMS data, including the daily backup of controlled substance prescription records that 21 CFR 1311.205(b)(17) requires (SOC 2 report, P09). Gaps: no immutable retention, one MSP administrator account without MFA, and never restore-tested.
evidence: PMS vendor SOC 2 report; SYS-07 job report (MSP)
